sections.content_markdown: 19. Draw the points $(-3, 2), (0, -5), \left(\frac{1}{2}, -\frac{5}{6}\right)$ on graph paper.
20. Draw the points $(1, 2), (-1, 1), (11, 7)$ on the graph paper and show that all the three points are on the same straight line.

21. Universal set $U = \{x : x \in \mathbb{N} \text{ and } x \text{ is an odd number\}}$
$A = \{x : x \in \mathbb{N} \text{ and } 2 \le x \le 7\}$
$B = \{x : x \in \mathbb{N} \text{ and } 3 < x < 6\}$
$C = \{x : x \in \mathbb{N} \text{ and } x^2 > 5 \text{ and } x^3 < 130\}$

1) Express set $A$ in tabular method.
2) Determine $A'$ and $C \setminus B$.
3) Determine $B \times C$ and $P(A \cap C)$.

1) Express the set $B$ in set building method.
2) Using the facts mentioned above, verify the relation $A \cup (B \cap C) = (A \cup B) \cap (A \cup C)$.
3) If $S = (B \cup C)^c \times A$ then determine $\text{dom } S$.
